homepage.q: Will aftermarket accessory fitment affect my car's manufacturer warranty?
homepage.a: No. Every electronic and lighting accessory is fitted using OEM-grade coupler-to-coupler harnesses with dedicated inline fuses. We do not cut, splice, or alter your vehicle's factory wiring looms, keeping manufacturer electrical warranties protected.

homepage.q: Where in Chennai is Bumper To Bumper Car Accessories located?
homepage.a: Our studio and fitment workshop is located at Shop No. 1, Survey No. 27/2A, The ARK, Jawaharlal Nehru Salai, Usha Nagar, Vanuvampet, Adambakkam, Chennai 600091 (along the Inner Ring Road). We have dedicated service bays for customer car inspections and installations.

homepage.q: How can I verify compatibility and enquire about accessories for my specific car model?
homepage.a: You can send your vehicle make, model, manufacturing year, and variant via WhatsApp to +91 97895 50006 or use our contact form. Our technical team checks exact bracket and harness compatibility and shares tailored recommendations.

homepage.q: What is the typical turnaround time for accessory installation?
homepage.a: Standard upgrades like wiper blades, 7D floor mats, dashcams, or horn upgrades generally take 45 to 90 minutes. Comprehensive fitments such as customized seat covers, 18-zone ambient lighting, or 360-degree camera systems usually require 3 to 5 hours for proper routing and optical calibration.

homepage.q: Can I inspect accessory samples before confirming my booking?
homepage.a: Yes. You are welcome to visit our Adambakkam studio to feel seat cover textures, view ambient light demos, inspect Android touchscreen displays, and compare beam cutoffs before finalizing your accessories.

about.q: What is the background of Bumper To Bumper Car Accessories?
about.a: Founded in Chennai with over 15 years of automotive aftermarket experience, Bumper To Bumper Car Accessories has upgraded more than 1,000 vehicles ranging from compact city cars to luxury SUVs, emphasizing clean craftsmanship and non-invasive installations.

about.q: What categories of car accessories do you supply and install?
about.a: Our catalog covers over 20 exterior and interior categories, including bi-LED projectors, fog lamps, aerodynamic spoilers, side foot steps, custom bucket seat covers, 7D mats, Android infotainment units, DSP audio setups, and 360-degree surround cameras.

about.q: What are your showroom and workshop operating hours?
about.a: We are open Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM, and on Sundays from 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM. Prior appointment via phone or WhatsApp is recommended for dedicated fitment bay scheduling.

about.q: How do I reach the store from nearby Chennai localities?
about.a: Our studio at The ARK on Jawaharlal Nehru Salai is easily accessible from Guindy, Velachery, Nanganallur, Madipakkam, and St. Thomas Mount, situated right on the main corridor in Vanuvampet, Adambakkam.

exterior.q: How do you ensure exterior electrical accessories are safe from water ingress?
exterior.a: All exterior lighting and sensor upgrades utilize weather-sealed, IP-rated connectors, silicone grommet seals, and heat-shrink sleeving. Relays and inline fuse holders are securely mounted in protected areas of the engine bay.

exterior.q: Are exterior styling accessories like spoilers and roof rails drill-free?
exterior.a: Most modern roof rails, side claddings, door visors, and spoilers use automotive-grade 3M acrylic foam tape and existing OEM mounting anchor points, eliminating the need for drilling into your car's sheet metal.

exterior.q: Can I upgrade halogen headlights to high-intensity LEDs without causing oncoming glare?
exterior.a: Yes. We recommend and install LEDs calibrated to match your vehicle's reflector or projector optics, ensuring a sharp cutoff line that maximizes road visibility while preventing beam scatter into oncoming drivers' eyes.

exterior.q: How do I request an estimate for exterior accessories?
exterior.a: Message our team on WhatsApp at +91 97895 50006 with your car model, current headlight setup, and desired styling upgrades. We will confirm item availability, compatibility, and fitment timelines.

exterior.q: Do you conduct quality checks after fitting exterior components?
exterior.a: Yes. Every installation undergoes a final handover checklist that includes beam alignment, relay triggering tests, fastener torque verification, and waterproof seal inspection.

interior.q: How are custom-fit seat covers tailored for vehicles with seat airbags?
interior.a: For vehicles equipped with side-impact seat airbags, seat covers are engineered with certified breakaway side seams or specific clearances that allow airbags to deploy without restriction.

interior.q: How does the Android infotainment system integrate with steering wheel controls and factory reverse cameras?
interior.a: Our touchscreen units include model-specific CANBUS decoders that preserve steering wheel audio controls, door-open alerts, climate display, and existing OEM or upgraded parking camera feeds.

interior.q: What materials are available for custom seat upholstery?
interior.a: We offer tailored seat covers in automotive-grade PU leather, breathable perforated Nappa-finish composites, and dual-tone stitch patterns customized to your vehicle's interior trim.

interior.q: How are ambient light strips routed inside the doors and dashboard?
interior.a: Ambient lighting optical fiber strips are neatly embedded along factory door seam crevices and dashboard contour lines. Wiring is routed through factory rubber door conduits so no wires are visible inside the cabin.

interior.q: What maintenance is recommended for 7D all-weather floor mats?
interior.a: Our 7D floor mats feature a detachable upper curly coil layer that traps dust and mud. You can unclip and shake out or pressure-wash the top mat while wiping down the water-resistant leatherette base.
